story.titleZh: 阿斯顿·马丁双车退赛，阿塞拜疆大奖赛提前收官
story.summaryZh: 阿斯顿·马丁车队官方宣布，斯特罗尔因疑似水压问题被要求在赛道上停车，阿隆索则因直道上失去速度而退赛，车队正在调查两个问题。

story.originalTitle: Our #AzerbaijanGP comes to an early end. Lance was asked to stop the car on track due to a suspected water pressure issue, with Fernando retiring afte...
story.summaryEn:
Our #AzerbaijanGP comes to an early end.
Lance was asked to stop the car on track due to a suspected water pressure issue, with Fernando retiring after losing speed on the straights.
The team are investigating both issues.
detailZh:
我们的阿塞拜疆大奖赛提前结束了。
由于疑似水压问题，斯特罗尔被要求将赛车停在赛道上，而阿隆索则因在直道上失去速度而退赛。
车队正在调查这两个问题。
detailEn:
Our #AzerbaijanGP comes to an early end.
Lance was asked to stop the car on track due to a suspected water pressure issue, with Fernando retiring after losing speed on the straights.
The team are investigating both issues.

Austin, we see you.
We know that there's more than one way to celebrate F1, and there's more than one side to Austin. That's why this #USGP, we're bringing I / AM to ATX to share in the race week rituals with local communities.
You. Us. Together.
Find out more: https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/news/feature/i-am-austin-for-the-new-generation-of-fans
detailZh:
奥斯汀，我们看到了你。
我们知道庆祝F1的方式不止一种，奥斯汀也有不止一面。这就是为什么在本届美国大奖赛，我们将I / AM带到ATX，与当地社区一起分享赛车周的仪式。
你。我们。一起。

Meet Yasmeen, one of three winners of the 2025 @aramco STEM Challenge.
From seeing carbon fibre manufacturing first-hand to tackling a race fuel strategy challenge, Yasmeen’s Immersion Week at the AMR Technology Campus brought her closer to the engineering behind an F1 car.
